footnote_text: This amendment corrects the Form 4 filed on 06/03/2026, which incorrectly reported the amount of securities beneficially owned following the reported transaction as 489,850. The actual amount was 498,736 shares of common stock. The share amount and the associated holdings reported in this amendment have been corrected accordingly. The amount-reporting-error also resulted in an understatement of the Reporting Person's holdings in subsequently filed Forms 4. Following the transaction dated 09/01/2026, the Reporting Person's direct beneficial ownership of shares of common stock, reported in Table I, Column 5 of the Form 4 filed on 09/01/2026, should have been 418,597 rather than 409,712. The numbers of shares sold in those subsequent Forms 4 were correctly reported and are unchanged. This amendment corrects a reporting error and does not reflect a new grant, cancellation, or disposition.
